title: Nvidia Board Unanimously Reinstates Jensen Huang as CEO
dek: The board reverses course while the independent probe keeps going.

facts.label: Interim CEO returns to CFO role

caption:
Jensen Huang is back as Nvidia CEO, just one week after the board signaled it wouldn't bring him back. 🔄

On November 23, Nvidia's board voted unanimously to restore Huang as president, CEO and board director, effective immediately. He had stepped down earlier this month after reports he was the target of a foreign intelligence effort. The board says talks with Huang and input from senior US government officials convinced it his return poses no national security risk. Colette Kress goes back to being CFO, and Harvey C. Jones stays on as chair.

The case isn't closed. An independent committee will finish its investigation with outside counsel, a new National Security and Export Control Committee is in place, and Nvidia is searching for a Chief Compliance Officer.

Why it matters: Nvidia's chips power most of today's AI models, and Vera Rubin systems are now shipping. We're following every twist of this story at AI Parabellum.
